nodes.title: Glossary
nodes.summary: Plain-language meaning of the words the Product Catalog wiki uses.

nodes.title: Home
nodes.summary: Entry page of the Product Catalog business-rules wiki, with its folders and how to read them.

nodes.title: A custom filter field replaces the standard field of its property
nodes.summary: When the standard filter field does not fit, such as a range slider for the rating, a small custom control takes its place and sets the filter (ADR-0020).

nodes.title: A dependent field offers only the values of its parent field
nodes.summary: The subcategory list shows only the subcategories of the chosen category, a mismatch is refused, and a changed category clears a foreign subcategory (ADR-0024).

nodes.title: A draft or locked product is marked in the list
nodes.summary: The product list marks a row that has a draft or is locked by another user, through the name column and without any custom code (ADR-0015).

nodes.title: A field is disabled until the field it depends on is filled
nodes.summary: A field that makes sense only after another field is filled stays disabled until then, and shows the required marker once it is enabled (ADR-0025).

nodes.title: Code lists use stable upper-case codes
nodes.summary: The lists the catalog keeps itself identify each value by a short stable upper-case code, and the screen shows the name (ADR-0010).

nodes.title: Documentation descriptions live in doc comments and the API document is generated
nodes.summary: One kind of doc comment describes every artefact, and the OpenAPI document, the code reference page and the JSDoc lint gate are generated or checked from it (ADR-0029).

nodes.title: Fixed lists of values are chosen from a dropdown showing names
nodes.summary: A short stable list such as the categories appears as a dropdown with names, while long or growing lists keep a search dialog (ADR-0011).

nodes.title: Pipeline decisions
nodes.summary: The decisions about the tooling, the agents and the documentation that build the catalog, each listed by title with a link to its ADR.

nodes.title: Product details are rows of reusable attributes
nodes.summary: A product holds detail rows, each pointing to an attribute that the product's subcategory offers, with at most one row per attribute (ADR-0026).

nodes.title: Product details are typed and shown as a generated form
nodes.summary: Each attribute has a value type, the draft creates one empty row per attribute of the subcategory, and one generic form shows them (ADR-0027).

nodes.title: Products are edited through drafts
nodes.summary: A product is created and changed in a private draft that becomes the product only on Save, with the standard Edit, Save and Cancel buttons (ADR-0012).

nodes.title: Products are imported from an Excel workbook
nodes.summary: An editor uploads an .xlsx file from the product list; every row is checked like a normal product and either all rows are created or none (ADR-0021).

nodes.title: The catalog data follows one set of modeling rules
nodes.summary: Every record has a generated identity and change tracking, lists of values are code lists, money and text have fixed shapes (ADR-0003).

nodes.title: The catalog is open to signed-in users with a viewer or editor role
nodes.summary: Every request needs a signed-in user, a viewer only reads, an editor does everything, and the screen hides the buttons a viewer cannot use (ADR-0013).

nodes.title: Validation rules follow one toolkit and prevent before they refuse
nodes.summary: The validation rules of issue 10 use declarative constraints with custom texts, two-field messages and a control that prevents the error first, and three proposed rules were not taken (ADR-0028).

nodes.title: Categories
nodes.summary: A category is the broad group a product belongs to, kept in a read-only list.

nodes.title: Detail attributes
nodes.summary: An attribute is a kind of fact a product can carry, with its value type, unit and limits.

nodes.title: Detail list values
nodes.summary: A list value is one allowed choice of an attribute that offers a list, with its display order.

nodes.title: Detail value types
nodes.summary: A value type says what kind of value an attribute takes: text, whole number, decimal, one choice or several choices.

nodes.title: Product detail selections
nodes.summary: A selection is one chosen value of a detail row whose attribute allows several choices.

nodes.title: Product details
nodes.summary: A detail row holds one attribute of a product and its typed value, such as the colour Black.

nodes.title: Products
nodes.summary: A product is the one thing the catalog holds, with a name, a price in a currency, a stock, a category, a subcategory and its details.

nodes.title: Subcategories
nodes.summary: A subcategory refines one category and decides which details a product offers.

nodes.title: Subcategory attributes
nodes.summary: An assignment says which attribute a subcategory offers and in which position its field appears.

nodes.title: Choose a category and subcategory
nodes.summary: Pick the category first, then a subcategory that belongs to it.

nodes.title: Create a product through a draft
nodes.summary: Create a product by filling a private draft and saving it, so it appears in the catalog only when complete.

nodes.title: Edit, save, keep or discard a draft
nodes.summary: Change an existing product through a draft, then save it, leave it for later or discard it.

nodes.title: Fill the details of a product
nodes.summary: Enter the typed details that the product's subcategory asks for, such as colour or weight.

nodes.title: Find a product
nodes.summary: Narrow the list of products by name, category, price or rating, and read the draft markers in the list.

nodes.title: Import products from Excel
nodes.summary: Create many products at once from an .xlsx workbook, all or nothing, with every bad row reported.

nodes.title: Who may do what
nodes.summary: Which actions each of the two catalog roles may use, and what an unsigned user gets.

nodes.title: A detail number stays within the bounds of its subcategory
nodes.summary: A subcategory will be able to narrow the bounds of a number attribute for its own products.

nodes.title: A detail that the subcategory requires must be filled
nodes.summary: A subcategory will be able to mark an attribute as required, and a product of that subcategory will need a value for it.

nodes.title: A detail value matches the value type of its attribute
nodes.summary: A value goes only in the place its attribute's value type allows: text for TEXT, a number for INTEGER and DECIMAL, one list value for LIST, selections for MULTI_LIST.

nodes.title: A list detail value belongs to the list of its attribute
nodes.summary: The value of a LIST attribute must be one of the values defined for that attribute and no other.

nodes.title: A number detail stays within its bounds and is whole when required
nodes.summary: A number value respects the minimum and maximum of its attribute, and an INTEGER attribute takes a whole number.

nodes.title: A price in a currency without minor units has no decimals
nodes.summary: A price in a currency without minor units, such as JPY or KRW, will have to be a whole amount.

nodes.title: A price is above zero
nodes.summary: A price will have to be above zero, so a free product is refused.

nodes.title: A product in stock needs a description
nodes.summary: A product with stock above zero will need a description.

nodes.title: A product is created and changed through a draft
nodes.summary: New and changed products are first kept as a private draft that is checked at Save, and a draft locks its product for other users and is marked in the list.

nodes.title: A product name has at least three characters
nodes.summary: A product name will need at least three characters once leading and trailing spaces are removed.

nodes.title: A product name is unique in the catalog
nodes.summary: A product name will have to be new in the catalog, ignoring capital letters and spaces at both ends.

nodes.title: A product needs a name, price, currency, stock, category and subcategory
nodes.summary: A product cannot be saved while its name, price, currency, stock, category or subcategory is empty.

nodes.title: A subcategory change must not leave details that do not fit
nodes.summary: A product is never stored with detail rows for attributes its subcategory does not offer; a draft drops them with a warning and a direct write is refused.

nodes.title: A value of a multi-choice detail is selected once and belongs to its list
nodes.summary: A several-choice row holds each chosen value once, every chosen value is required and belongs to the attribute's list.

nodes.title: An attribute is used once per product and belongs to the subcategory
nodes.summary: A detail row names an attribute that its product's subcategory offers, and a product has at most one row per attribute.

nodes.title: An image address uses https and has no spaces
nodes.summary: The image address of a product will have to start with https and contain no spaces.

nodes.title: An import creates all products or none
nodes.summary: An Excel import writes every row as an active product, or writes nothing and lists every problem of the file at once.

nodes.title: An imported product name must be new
nodes.summary: A row is refused when its name equals the name of an active product or of an earlier row of the same file.

nodes.title: Battery life is available only for a wireless device
nodes.summary: The battery life of a product will be enabled only while the product has a wireless connection value selected.

nodes.title: Category, subcategory and currency must exist
nodes.summary: A product can only name a category, a subcategory and a currency that exist in the catalog's lists.

nodes.title: Changing the category clears a subcategory that no longer fits
nodes.summary: When the category of a draft changes, a subcategory that belongs to the old category is cleared at once and without a message.

nodes.title: Code lists are readable by every signed-in user
nodes.summary: Categories, subcategories, currencies and the other fixed lists are open to reading for any signed-in user, and no role changes them.

nodes.title: Detail rows follow the attributes of the subcategory
nodes.summary: A draft keeps one detail row per attribute of the product's subcategory and tells the user which filled values were dropped when the subcategory changes.

nodes.title: Every imported row follows the rules of a product
nodes.summary: Each row is written through the same checks as any product, and a row that breaks one is reported with its row number, column and reason.

nodes.title: Memory is a power of two
nodes.summary: The memory of a laptop will have to be a power of two.

nodes.title: Only signed-in users reach the catalog
nodes.summary: Every request to the catalog, including reading and the service description, needs a signed-in user.

nodes.title: Price, stock and rating stay within their bounds
nodes.summary: The price is from 0 to 99,999,999.99, the stock from 0 to 1,000,000 and the rating from 0 to 5.

nodes.title: Storage is not below memory
nodes.summary: The storage of a laptop will not be allowed to be below its memory.

nodes.title: The header row names known columns once and includes the mandatory ones
nodes.summary: The first row of the workbook may name only the supported columns, each once, and must include name, price, currency, stock, category and subcategory.

nodes.title: The import file is an xlsx workbook with product rows within the size limits
nodes.summary: The file must be a readable .xlsx workbook with at least one product row, at most 1,000 rows, and not more than 10 MB of unpacked data.

nodes.title: The subcategory belongs to the product's category
nodes.summary: A product carries only a subcategory of its own category, so a pair from two categories is never stored.

nodes.title: The subcategory field stays disabled until a category is chosen
nodes.summary: On the product form the Subcategory field cannot be used until a category is chosen, and it is marked required from then on.

nodes.title: Viewers read, editors change
nodes.summary: A viewer only reads products, an editor also creates, changes, deletes and imports them, and the screen hides the buttons a viewer cannot use.
